statements.t: “SpyGlass Pharma continued to execute our objectives over the course of the quarter as we aim to alter the treatment paradigm for glaucoma patients.

In parallel, enrollment in our Phase 3 trials of the BIM-IOL System remains on track, and we have secured long-term commercial manufacturing supply of the IOL for the BIM-IOL System and have become a supplier of other world-class IOLs,” stated Patrick Mooney, chief executive officer of SpyGlass Pharma.
